title: BCC Ruling No. 16-26-1454 — vertical cable guard openings
code_edition: Ontario Building Code 2012, O. Reg. 332/12 (as cited)

facts.text: The dispute concerns a pre-engineered vertical cable guard on an elevated deck of a new one-storey, 210 m² dwelling at 1667-1 Acton Island Road.
The question is whether the cable openings prevent passage of a 100 mm sphere under Article 9.8.8.5.
The applicant described an Intertek test report at 200 lb and 300 lb cable tensions, with reported maximum loads of 5.1 lb and 14.8 lb before sphere passage.
